faq.q: What is included in the dolphin watching brunch cruise?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The brunch is served onboard, with fresh pastries, fruit, and light bites, along with a glass of cava as you set off.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the dolphin brunch cruise?
faq.a: We offer a range of boats from Puerto Banús. For a 2-hour brunch cruise, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal and cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For a more premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski.

faq.q: When is the best time to see dolphins in Marbella?
faq.a: Dolphins are most active in the Mediterranean from spring to autumn (April–October). Early morning cruises (9:00–11:00) often offer calmer seas and higher sighting chances. However, sightings are never guaranteed—it's a wild experience, and we respect the animals' natural habitat.

faq.q: Can we swim during the cruise?
faq.a: Yes, we usually include a swimming stop in a sheltered cove, such as Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, weather permitting. The skipper will choose the best spot based on sea conditions. Life jackets are provided, and the crew will assist if needed.

faq.q: Is the brunch suitable for children?
faq.a: Absolutely. The brunch includes child-friendly options like fruit, pastries, and soft drinks. The boats are family-friendly, and the skipper will ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 both have shaded areas, perfect for little ones.

faq.q: How do we book and what is the cancellation policy?
faq.a: Booking is via WhatsApp for the fastest confirmation. We require a 50% deposit to secure your date, with the balance due on the day. Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure; within 72 hours, the deposit is non-refundable unless we cancel due to weather.

faq.q: What happens if we don't see any dolphins?
faq.a: While we can't guarantee sightings, our skippers know the best spots and monitor marine activity. In the unlikely event you see none, you still enjoy the brunch, swimming, and the beautiful coastline. We don't offer refunds for no sightings, but we do offer a 10% discount on your next cruise.

data.body_html:
Imagine gliding out of Puerto Banús on a luxury motor yacht, the morning sun warming your skin, a glass of cava in hand, and the promise of wild dolphins breaking the surface ahead. That's the Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise—a 2 to 4-hour experience that combines the thrill of spotting bottlenose dolphins in their natural habitat with a gourmet brunch served onboard. Departing from the glamorous port of Puerto Banús, this cruise is perfect for families, couples, and small groups who want a taste of the Mediterranean's beauty without sacrificing comfort.

Why Choose a Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline is a haven for marine life, with the warm waters of the Alboran Sea attracting pods of dolphins year-round. A dedicated brunch cruise offers a structured yet relaxed way to experience this. Unlike a standard boat trip, you get a curated culinary experience, a comfortable deck to lounge on, and a skipper who knows exactly where to look. Plus, you avoid the crowded tourist boats—our charters are private, so it's just you and your group.

What's on the Brunch Menu?

Our brunch is designed to be light yet satisfying, perfect for a morning at sea. Expect fresh pastries, seasonal fruit, Spanish tortilla, cured meats, and artisan cheeses. We also serve a selection of sandwiches and wraps. To drink, there's freshly squeezed orange juice, coffee, and of course, a bottle of cava or white wine to toast your dolphin sighting. All beverages—including beer and soft drinks—are included, as are light snacks throughout the cruise.

Our Fleet for Dolphin Watching Cruises

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, ensuring easy access and a quick exit to open water. Here's a quick look at the options:

For a more exclusive experience, the Mangusta 80 offers a 4-hour cruise with a free jet ski included—a great option for thrill-seekers. Other boats like the Fairline Targa 12m or Pershing 46 are available on request; pricing is via WhatsApp.

Best Time of Year for Dolphin Sightings

The Alboran Sea is home to a resident population of bottlenose dolphins, with sightings common from April to October. The summer months (June–August) offer the best weather, with average sea temperatures of 22–25°C, but also more boat traffic. Spring and autumn provide calmer seas and fewer crowds, making dolphin spotting easier. Early morning departures (around 9:00) tend to have the highest success rates, as the sea is usually flatter and dolphins are more active.

What to Expect Onboard

Your cruise begins at Puerto Banús, where you'll be welcomed by your skipper and crew. After a safety briefing, you'll set off along the coast, passing landmarks like the Marbella Marina and the iconic La Concha mountain. The skipper will head towards known dolphin hotspots, often near the Cabopino coastline or further out towards the open sea. While you wait for sightings, enjoy the brunch, sunbathe on the deck, or take in the views of the Golden Mile. If conditions allow, we'll stop for a swim in a sheltered cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

How to Book Your Cruise

Booking is simple. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, you can book directly online or via WhatsApp. For other boats, message us on WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak season. A 50% deposit secures your date, with the balance due on the day. Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure.

Ready to set sail? Explore more of our [boat rental experiences](/experiences/) or return to the [Marbella boat charter hub](/) to see all options.

We offer a range of boats from Puerto Banús. For a 2-hour brunch cruise, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal and cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For a more premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski.

Dolphins are most active in the Mediterranean from spring to autumn (April–October). Early morning cruises (9:00–11:00) often offer calmer seas and higher sighting chances. However, sightings are never guaranteed—it's a wild experience, and we respect the animals' natural habitat.

Booking is via WhatsApp for the fastest confirmation. We require a 50% deposit to secure your date, with the balance due on the day. Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure; within 72 hours, the deposit is non-refundable unless we cancel due to weather.
